_comment: Behaviours a security fix CHANGED. A contract, smoke or snapshot test that still asserts the pre-fix behaviour encodes the vulnerability as a requirement — and after the fix it fails while pointing AT the fix, so it arrives dressed as a regression and argues for reintroducing the hole. This registry makes that mechanical. It bit twice inside a single smoke entry on 2026-08-02 and the second was caught only on a re-read, so a human re-read is not the control.

fixes.reason: The webhook secret check fired only on a PRESENTED mismatch, so an anonymous POST that omitted the header reached the handler. isAuthorized also failed open. Both now fail closed.

POST had no inbound authentication and the route supplies PI_CEO_PASSWORD upstream itself. No smoke surface asserted the pre-fix behaviour, so pre_fix_status is null — the entry exists so a future contract cannot assert an unauthenticated 2xx here.
